name: wanapis-media
description: Generate images and video from inside Codex — including GPT Image 2.5, MiniMax H3 with multi-reference and 2K regeneration, and Seedance with local-file upload, verified model parameters, async results and public-price budget estimates through one WanAPIs key.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit images and video with cost estimates
interface.longDescription: Create images and video through verified WanAPIs adapters, including GPT Image 2.5 with independent quality and resolution, MiniMax H3 with multi-image/frame/video/audio references, upload, 2K regeneration, standalone prompt optimization, priority and IR options, and Seedance with local-file upload and reference media. The model list intersects the current public catalog with supported adapters. Budget estimates use public pricing and an assumed group multiplier; H3 reference media is shown as a reservation upper bound and pending settlement is not a final charge. Actual image usage can cost more. Completed tasks report billing status and the gateway's charged amount when settled.
defaultPrompt: Generate a 5-second video of a paper plane gliding over a city at dusk
Make a product hero image of a ceramic mug on a linen backdrop
What would a 10-second 1080p clip cost on each video model?
